2) **Booking details:** All present in the detail card — Doctor (Dr. Rajesh), Clinic (Rajesh Clinic), Date (Tomorrow), Time (10:30), Fee (₹300 · pay at clinic), plus bonus fields (city, patient, reason).

3) **Token/status card:** Yes — a prominent card with "Request sent" status, "Token being assigned" headline, clear explanation, and a 3-step progress tracker (Booked → Confirmed → Completed).

4) **Store-listing quality:** Professional, uncluttered, well-structured with clear CTAs (Track queue, Share token, Cancel booking).

VERDICT: PASS — clean, professional token screen with all booking details and a clear status card.
